- Notes: Removed Cast(valid_bool BOOL->F32) -> valid_mask and Greater(valid_mask, 0) -> tail_cond.
  Rewired Where to use valid_bool directly as condition. The Cast->Greater(_,0) sequence
  is the identity transformation for bool tensors (True->1>0=True, False->0>0=False).
  Saves valid_mask (432 bytes F32) and tail_cond (108 bytes BOOL).
